title.zh-CN: Public RC 原典对读：心经、道德经与论语
title.en: Public RC passage reading: Heart Sutra, Daodejing and Analects

question.zh-CN: 三段已审核的原典入口如何分别回到文本、版本、定位与传述？
question.en: How do three reviewed passages return to their texts, versions, locators and transmission contexts?

disclaimer.zh-CN: 这是当前 Public RC 的文本入口，不把三段文字判定为同一命题；每一栏都保留自己的文本、版本、定位和证据边界。
disclaimer.en: This is the current Public RC textual gateway, not a claim that the three passages express one proposition; each column retains its own text, version, locator and evidence boundary.

description.zh-CN: 把作品、版本和段落放在同一条可追溯链上。
description.en: Keeps work, version and passage on one traceable chain.

description.zh-CN: 显示章次/篇章定位，避免名句脱离文本。
description.en: Shows chapter or section locators so a saying is not detached from its text.

description.zh-CN: 并排显示当前原文和断句，不把译文冒充原典。
description.en: Places source wording and punctuation side by side without treating translation as source text.

description.zh-CN: 区分传统归属、文本保存和后世解释。
description.en: Separates traditional attribution, textual preservation and later interpretation.

description.zh-CN: 保留现代中文和英文展示，同时明确它们不是原文。
description.en: Keeps modern Chinese and English display layers distinct from the source wording.

description.zh-CN: 区分文本形成、传述和版本语境的时间。
description.en: Separates textual formation, transmission and version-context time.

description.zh-CN: 把来源、定位、证据等级和权利边界放回阅读入口。
description.en: Returns sources, locators, evidence grades and rights boundaries to the reading entry point.

title.zh-CN: 三传统原典对读：语句、版本与传述
title.en: Three-tradition passage reading: wording, versions and transmission

question.zh-CN: 当三段言说被并排阅读时，我们能分别看见哪些文本层、归属层和后世解释？
question.en: When three passages are read side by side, which textual, attribution and later-interpretive layers remain visible?

disclaimer.zh-CN: 这不是把三段文字判定为同一命题，也不是同一文本的异文校勘；每一栏都回到自己的文本、版本、定位和传述证据。
disclaimer.en: This is neither a claim that the three passages express one proposition nor a collation of variants within one text; each column returns to its own text, version, locator and transmission evidence.

description.zh-CN: 把文本、具体版本和段落放在同一条可追溯链上。
description.en: Keeps text, specific version and passage on one traceable chain.

description.zh-CN: 显示原始定位与规范化定位，避免名句脱离篇章。
description.en: Shows original and normalised locators so a saying is not detached from its chapter or work.

description.zh-CN: 并排显示原文和当前断句；不把译文冒充原典。
description.en: Places source wording and current punctuation side by side without treating translation as the source text.

description.zh-CN: 区分传统说话者、传述者和复合文本的保存状态。
description.en: Separates traditional speaker attribution from the way a composite text was preserved.

description.zh-CN: 同时保留现代汉语和英文解释，并明确它们不是原文。
description.en: Keeps modern Chinese and English interpretation visible while marking them as distinct from the source wording.

description.zh-CN: 区分人物生平、文本形成和传世版本的时间。
description.en: Separates a figure's lifetime from textual formation and received-version history.

description.zh-CN: 把来源、定位、证据等级和版本权利放回阅读入口。
description.en: Returns sources, locators, evidence grades and version rights to the reading entry point.

title.zh-CN: 《转法轮经》版本对读：巴利语与 Thanissaro 英译
title.en: Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta version reading: Pāli and Thanissaro English

question.zh-CN: 同一经文的巴利语短引与现代英译，哪些层面可以对照，哪些差异必须保留？
question.en: What can be compared between a Pāli excerpt and a modern English translation of one discourse, and which differences must remain visible?

disclaimer.zh-CN: 这是同一文本的语言版本对读，不是巴利语手稿异文校勘；“suffering / stress”只作为译者措辞差异记录，不裁定唯一译法。
disclaimer.en: This is a language-version reading within one text, not a collation of Pāli manuscripts; “suffering / stress” records translator wording without declaring a single authorised rendering.

description.zh-CN: 确认两段都回到同一部经文，同时显示各自的 text version。
description.en: Confirms the shared discourse while showing each explicit text version.

description.zh-CN: 比较共同的 SN 56.11 定位与各版本的引用界面。
description.en: Compares the shared SN 56.11 locator with each version's citation interface.

description.zh-CN: 把巴利语原文与英译措辞并排，不把译文伪装成原语异文。
description.en: Places Pāli wording beside translation wording without presenting translation as a source-language variant.

description.zh-CN: 两种版本都保留传统说话者与传述保存层。
description.en: Both witnesses retain traditional speaker attribution and mediated preservation.

description.zh-CN: 显示译者选择如何影响观众接收到的意义，不把一个词译法定为唯一答案。
description.en: Shows how translation choices shape reception without declaring one rendering the only answer.

description.zh-CN: 区分经文传述/文本层与现代英译版本的时间。
description.en: Separates the transmitted textual layer from the modern English version.

description.zh-CN: 每一列都保留来源、权利边界和 reviewer evidence。
description.en: Each column retains sources, rights boundaries and reviewer evidence.
